newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar takes downturn after NYK open.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar takes downturn after NYK open.

text.p: White sugar futures renewed their recent weakness as selling in the New York raws market prompted trade players to offload nearby LIFFE whites positions and also sell the March arbitrage, traders said on Tuesday.
After spending the morning stable to slightly firmer, London's spot December contract lost ground to touch support at $328 but then recovered after light trade buying at the dips.
One leading London trade house was said to have been the best seller of the afternoon, countering the effect of earlier commission house buying.
At 1623 GMT December was down 80 cents at $329.50 and March down $1.60 at $328.50. All other traded positions were weaker and overall volume reached 1,532 lots.
The trading pattern was similar in Paris where 517 lots were traded. December was down $1.00 at $329.00 and March down $2.10 at $328.40.
